title: Animate Present TypeScript Packages
description: Create animate/present TypeScript packages (core + renderer/react) to replace missing framework/product/presentation core and renderer. Update projektetage to use new packages.
summary:
Created animate/present TypeScript packages to replace missing framework/product/presentation core and renderer.

**@semio-tech/animate-present-core** — full declarative presentation domain model (chapters/sequences/thoughts/slides, participants, embodiments, dispositions, arrangements, split/morph helpers) recovered from git history into `animate/present/core/js/internal.ts`, re-exported from `index.ts` with 112 vitest tests matching projektetage expectations.

**@semio-tech/animate-present-renderer-react** — reveal.js + @semio-tech/ui-react surface chrome renderer with Expertise enum, mountPresentation, PresentationDeck, auto-animate morph support; 272 vitest tests passing.

**Workspace** — `animate/present/package.json` with core + renderer/react workspaces; added to root package.json workspaces.

**projektetage migration** — mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage updated to depend on new packages (package.json, vite.config.ts aliases, js/index.ts imports, all 27 slide/*.ts files); 56 vitest tests passing.

framework/product/presentation left untouched per instruction.
